{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()
num_completed_before = len(completed_orders)
num_completed_after = len(completed_orders[~qa_mask])

# Remove QA orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue of valid completed orders
mean_revenue = valid_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of completed orders before filtering QA: {num_completed_before}")
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {num_qa_orders}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering QA: {num_completed_after}")
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
